items.text: Fixed full‑height walls where the bottom face could incorrectly connect to the top face of a neighboring wall.
Added a full voxel‑based visibility flood for each base to correctly detect missing sockets and incorrect block connections.
Disabled research and crafting for the UZI 9mm, removing it from the tech tree.
Fixed a sight‑mod bug where ADS values were overridden when the stock was collapsed.
Corrected night‑vision goggle sound restarting when gesturing.
Fixed mortar ammo indicator not updating correctly.
Fixed the loadouts UI delete confirmation popup being uninteractive.
Prevented monument placement where terrain blend maps overlap river topology, stopping floating water glitches.
Various swarm fixes: corrected crab and jellyfish job behavior and made rare blue crab color tints more noticeable.
Fixed beacon repairable collider so it no longer blocks ladders, preventing players from climbing near beacons.
Fixed crow flock error, restoring proper crow behavior.
Server admins can now force gull groups to startle or land via console commands, and gulls no longer clip through obstacles.
Bird interest zones can be placed in monuments to attract flocks; corpses briefly draw crows, and explosions cause birds to flee the area.
Seagull groups have been added to the livestock scene, increasing wildlife activity there.
Bird hit detection bounds have been increased, keeping birds within hit‑registration range and reducing missed shots.

items.text: Boat AI improvements: dead driver flags cleared, smoother scientist boat movement with better avoidance and unsticking, roaming boats now patrol closer to coast (35 m) and stop chasing hidden players after 45 s, and lingering boat spawn bugs fixed.

Scientist AI targeting overhauled to remember lost target locations, auto‑switch to visible players, and continue attacking hidden targets for more stable encounters; also fixed a movement‑initialization bug that kept sleeping AI from receiving their first movement tick.
UZI tweaks: recoil adjusted, stock changes now block other actions, holstering cancels stock‑change animation, first‑shot animation fixed, and ADS settings refined.
Cannon dismount rotation fixed so players face the correct direction after leaving a cannon on a boat.
Item system stability: fixed stacking, use‑after‑free bugs in consumables and item durability, and other removal bugs that could cause items to disappear or malfunction.
New craftables added: Wool Armor (costs 20 wool, Tier 1 protection) and Shears (crafted from 2 blades).
Scientist loot updates: 20 % chance for a blueprint page on RHIBs and 20 % chance for a blueprint book on PT boats.
Apple spawn rebalanced: removed from oak_d, increased spawn chance on oak_e to 50 %; beehive natural‑kill warning fixed.
Seagull groups introduced: land at interest points, can be startled, transition to flocks, have hitboxes, can be shot, with improved flock movement.
Vendor crate spawning now includes missing blueprint fragments and livestock vendor rewards upgraded from fragments to full blueprint pages.
Radiation issue with the water gun fixed.
Shears no longer hurt or startle sheep (they still deal small damage to other entities).
Item stack events now correctly fire OnItemAdded and OnItemRemovedFromStack, fixing inventory‑related scripts and automation.
Ladder hatches can now be closed from any angle, restoring full interaction.
